1.web: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.
1.asv: In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.

2.web: His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.
2.asv: In Salem also is his tabernacle, And his dwelling-place in Zion.

3.web: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
3.asv: There he brake the arrows of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. [Selah

4.web: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
4.asv: Glorious art thou and excellent, From the mountains of prey.

5.web: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
5.asv: The stouthearted are made a spoil, They have slept their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.

6.web: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.
6.asv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

7.web: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
7.asv: Thou, even thou, art to be feared; And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

8.web: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,
8.asv: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,

9.web: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.
9.asv: When God arose to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. [Selah

10.web: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.
10.asv: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: The residue of wrath shalt thou gird upon thee.

11.web: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
11.asv: Vow, and pay unto Jehovah your God: Let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

12.web: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
12.asv: He will cut off the spirit of princes: He is terrible to the kings of the earth.
